ez-tree 1.1.0 (MIT, Daniel Greenheck), https://github.com/dgreenheck/ez-tree, npm integrity checked.
Changed for plain browser ES modules: .js on relative imports, textures by URL, presets as data.js.
Bark textures: Poly Haven (CC0) and TextureCan (CC0), see assets/bark/README.md.
Fix: tree.js leaf wind shader applies instanceMatrix (USE_INSTANCING), so InstancedMesh leaves sit on their trees.
Change: branch and leaf materials are MeshStandardMaterial (PBR, take the scene's environment light) instead of MeshPhongMaterial.
